cover_headline: World Champion Gukesh Named to TIME100 Next India Weeks Before First Title Defence

end.headline: World Champion Gukesh Named to TIME100 Next India Weeks Before First Title Defence
end.line: The 20-year-old appears in the Phenoms category of TIME's first country-specific Next list, with his profile written by Sharda Ugra.

facts: Gukesh Dommaraju appears in the Phenoms category of TIME100 Next India, the first international edition of TIME's TIME100 Next franchise
In December 2024 he defeated Ding Liren to become the youngest undisputed world chess champion in history, at 18
Later this month he defends the world title for the first time, against Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov
